metaDescription: Reach EdLight Initiative by email or through our contact form. We reply to students, volunteers, partners, and donors within two to three business days.
shareDescription: Reach EdLight Initiative by email or through our contact form. We reply within two to three business days.

hero.title: Get in touch
hero.subtitle: Questions about a programme, an offer to help, a partnership, or a gift — this reaches the team directly.

email.title: Email
email.note: The fastest way to reach us.

location.title: Where we are
location.note: Registered as a Canadian not-for-profit corporation (No. {number}). Our programmes serve students across {area}.

response.title: Response time
response.note: Monday to Friday, Eastern Time. We read everything that comes in.

beforeYouWrite.heading: Before you write
beforeYouWrite.body: Many questions about eligibility, cost, and how to apply are already answered on the <faqLink>FAQ page</faqLink>. If you want to volunteer or partner with us, the <involvedLink>Get Involved page</involvedLink> has a form built for that.

form.heading: Send us a message
form.emailRequired: We need an email address to reply to.
form.emailInvalid: That does not look like a valid email address.
form.subjectRequired: A short subject helps us route your message.
form.subjectPlaceholder: Applying to a programme, volunteering, partnership…
form.messageRequired: Please tell us what you need.
form.messageMinLength: A little more detail will help us answer properly.
form.success: Thank you — your message is with us. We usually reply within two to three business days.
form.error: Something went wrong sending that. Please try again, or email us directly at <link>{email}</link>.
form.replyNote: We usually reply within two to three business days.
